note: mDC: myeloid (conventional) dendritic cells — main cluster spanning mid-to-high CD11c (CD11c+); a small cluster at low CD11c (CD11c-) on the far left is excluded.
tips: Positive selection of myeloid DCs within Non_pDC. mDC: CD11c+ (integrin αX; pan-myeloid DC marker; conventional DCs are CD11c-high). The remaining CD11c- events are not annotated. In-panel co-marker prior: HLA-DR (Comp-BV510-A, from Step 14 parent) is uniformly high on mDCs — events should cluster at HLA-DR-high; HLA-DR-dim CD11c+ events would be atypical and suggest residual NK-like contamination.
